description: Chandan Kashyap is a software engineer working on distributed systems, cloud security, and AI-assisted developer workflows.

photo.alt: Chandan Kashyap with snow-covered mountains and Tilicho Lake in the background.

bio: I’m a Senior Software Engineer at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, working on Key Management Service. I build secure distributed systems, HSM-backed services, and the tools engineers use to operate them.

My work spans Java and native systems: service modernization, dedicated KMS infrastructure, audit delivery, and recovery workflows. I care about correctness, clear failure behavior, and making complex systems easier to understand.

I also use Codex in day-to-day engineering, apply reusable agent skills to production debugging and root-cause analysis, and build harnesses that help other developers run repeatable end-to-end tests.

work.title: Modernizing a security-critical Java dataplane
work.label: Runtime engineering
work.summary: Modernized a KMS Java dataplane while preserving compatibility and evaluating performance under realistic workloads. Added observability to make rollout behavior easier to verify.

work.title: Dedicated KMS infrastructure and recovery
work.label: Secure infrastructure
work.summary: Built HSM Agent and CavServer capabilities for dedicated HSM clusters, including partition lifecycle operations, backup and recovery integration, and native telemetry.

work.title: Customer audit delivery
work.label: Reliability & auditability
work.summary: Delivered a pipeline that moves signed HSM audit logs to customer storage, with integrity checks, retry handling, and operational health signals.

work.title: Codex-assisted engineering and incident investigation
work.label: AI-assisted development
work.summary: Use Codex for agentic coding, implementation, debugging, test development, and review. Apply reusable agent skills to correlate service logs and investigate production failures across KMS components.

work.title: Reusable end-to-end testing harnesses
work.label: Developer experience
work.summary: Build harnesses that let other engineers reproduce KMS workflows and run repeatable end-to-end tests across service boundaries. Focus on useful validation evidence and understandable failure reports.

experience.detail: Key Management Service: secure distributed services, dedicated HSM infrastructure, operational reliability, and developer tooling.
Built billing and payout workflows, Kafka consumers, invoice generation, and merchant statement automation using Java, Spring, and Spark.
Built backend-for-frontend services, aggregation APIs, caching, observability, and performance-focused tests.
